name: 369chats-app
//expo-doctor: These three are KNOWINGLY accepted, not ignored. All are flagged only against the New Architecture, which this app does not use (app.json sets newArchEnabled: false). @react-native-cookies/cookies is also deprecated upstream — it is here solely so JS can read the Odoo session cookie for the websocket handshake (services/odooBus.js); if the app ever moves to the New Architecture it must be swapped for react-native-nitro-cookies or @preeternal/react-native-cookie-manager, and calling will stop ringing until it is. @notifee/react-native is unmaintained but is the only thing providing the full-screen alarm intent. They are excluded so expo-doctor stays a MEANINGFUL gate — it is what would have caught the expo-asset mismatch below, and a check that always fails gets ignored.
//overrides: expo-audio declares `expo-asset: *` as a PEER, and npm answers a wildcard with the newest published version — that pulled expo-asset@57 (an SDK 57 package) into the top of node_modules, displacing expo@54's own ~12.0.13 into node_modules/expo/. Gradle autolinks whatever is at the top level, so release builds shipped the SDK 57 AssetModule against expo-modules-core@3.0.30 and died on launch with NoClassDefFoundError: AnyTypeCache (expo-modules-core inlines that class into consumers, so the mismatch surfaces inside AssetModule). Neither jest nor expo export can catch this — both are JS-only. The direct dependency above fixes today's tree; this override is what stops the wildcard re-opening it on the next npm install.
